title: wall cabinet in nightstand size.
text: wall cabinet in nightstand size.. ummm, I thought this was a wall cabinet, not nightstand size???  It's beautiful don't get me wrong but it's much much smaller than I expected!  No assembly required since it's basically as tall as a nightstand and about half as thin.  It even comes with wall screws so you won't pull it over on yourself (or maybe so your pet ferret won't).  Not what I was expecting at all even though it is a pretty design- thought it was a full size cabinet which would have been awesome - this... I have no idea what to do with

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Farmhouse Wall Mounted Cabinet Storage Organzier - 23 x19 x 6 Inch, Natural Wood
features: This wall cabinet provides vintage style along with storage space for spices, mail and more in your kitchen or entryway. Display small objects or stash your keys in the three cubbies on the bottom. The distressed finish adds to the antique appeal.
Constructed from hardwood; iron hinges and door pulls
Ready to hang, all hardware included
